# Vendored Obsidian Linter

Source: https://github.com/platers/obsidian-linter
Version: 1.33.0
Commit: b15df18a182bbbc750209a8913a89469a164d01a
License: MIT (LICENSE)

src is unchanged upstream source. Three unchanged selected suites are in
__tests__: trailing-spaces, remove-multiple-spaces and heading-blank-lines.
Adapters are outside this directory; upstream UI option metadata is replaced
at bundle time, and the test common runner is adapted without changing cases.
